GROUP BY c.CountryId, c.CountryName
HAVING COUNT(cm.Id) > 3

FROM car_makers cm
JOIN countries c ON cm.Country = c.CountryId
WHERE cm.Maker = 'fiat'

SELECT 
    T2.Country AS Id, 
    T1.CountryName
FROM 
    countries T1

    car_makers T2 
ON 
    T1.CountryId = T2.Country
GROUP BY 
    T2.Country
HAVING 
    COUNT(T2.Country) > 3

UNION

    T2.Country AS Id, 
    T1.CountryName
FROM 
    countries T1 
JOIN 
    car_makers T2 
ON 
    T1.CountryId = T2.Country
WHERE

SELECT c.CountryId, c.CountryName
FROM countries c
JOIN car_makers cm ON c.CountryId = cm.Country
GROUP BY c.CountryId, c.CountryName
HAVING COUNT(cm.Id) > 3

UNION

FROM countries c
JOIN car_makers cm ON c.CountryId = cm.Country
JOIN model_list ml ON cm.Id = ml.Maker
JOIN car_names cn ON ml.Model = cn.Model
WHERE cn.Make = 'fiat'

WITH CarMakerCount AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CountryName,
        COUNT(cm.Id) AS MakerCount
    FROM car_makers cm
    JOIN countries c ON cm.Country = c.CountryId
    GROUP BY c.CountryName
    HAVING MakerCount > 3
),
FiatProducer AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CountryName
    FROM car_makers cm
    JOIN model_list ml ON cm.Id = ml.Maker
    JOIN countries c ON cm.Country = c.CountryId
    WHERE ml.Model = 'fiat'
)
SELECT 
    CountryName
FROM CarMakerCount
UNION
SELECT 
    CountryName
FROM FiatProducer

SELECT 
  T1.Country, 
  T2.CountryName 
FROM 
  car_makers AS T1
JOIN 
  countries AS T2 ON T1.Country = T2.CountryId
GROUP BY 
  T1.Country, T2.CountryName
HAVING 
  COUNT(T1.Id) > 3 
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM car_makers AS T3 
    JOIN car_names AS T4 ON T3.Maker = T4.MakeId 
    WHERE T3.Country = T1.Country AND T4.Make = 'fiat'
  )

SELECT 
    c.CountryId, 
    c.CountryName
FROM 
    car_makers cm
INNER JOIN 
    countries c ON cm.Country = c.CountryId
WHERE 
    cm.Maker = 'fiat'
OR 
    c.CountryId IN (
        SELECT 
            cm.Country 
        FROM 
            car_makers cm
        GROUP BY 
            cm.Country
        HAVING 
            COUNT(*) > 3
    )

WITH car_makers_per_country AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CountryId, 
    c.CountryName,
    COUNT(cm.Id) AS car_makers_count
  FROM countries c
  LEFT JOIN car_makers cm ON c.CountryId = cm.Country
  GROUP BY c.CountryId, c.CountryName
),
fiat_producers AS (
  SELECT 
    cm.Country AS CountryId
  FROM car_makers cm
  WHERE cm.Maker = 'fiat'
)
SELECT 
  cm.CountryId,
  c.CountryName
FROM car_makers_per_country cm
JOIN countries c ON cm.CountryId = c.CountryId
WHERE cm.car_makers_count > 3
UNION
SELECT 
  cm.CountryId,
  c.CountryName
FROM fiat_producers fp
JOIN countries c ON fp.CountryId = c.CountryId
JOIN car_makers cm ON fp.CountryId = cm.Country
WHERE cm.Maker = 'fiat'

WITH CountryMakerCount AS (
    SELECT
        c.Country,
        COUNT(cm.Id) AS MakerCount
    FROM
        car_makers cm
    JOIN
        countries c ON cm.Country = c.CountryId
    GROUP BY
        c.Country
),
FiatMakerCountry AS (
    SELECT
        cm.Country AS FiatCountry
    FROM
        car_makers cm
    WHERE
        cm.Maker = 'fiat'
)
SELECT
    c.CountryId,
    c.CountryName
FROM
    countries c
JOIN
    CountryMakerCount cmc ON c.CountryId = cmc.Country
WHERE
    cmc.MakerCount > 3
UNION
SELECT
    c.CountryId,
    c.CountryName
FROM
    countries c
JOIN
    FiatMakerCountry fmc ON c.CountryId = fmc.FiatCountry

WITH car_makers_per_country AS (
  SELECT c.CountryName, COUNT(cm.Id) as maker_count
  FROM car_makers cm
  JOIN countries c ON cm.Country = c.CountryId
  GROUP BY c.CountryName
),
countries_with_fiat AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.CountryName
  FROM car_makers cm
  JOIN countries c ON cm.Country = c.CountryId
  JOIN model_list ml ON cm.Id = ml.Maker
  WHERE ml.Model = 'Fiat'
)

SELECT 
    c.Name, 
    c.IndepYear, 
    c.SurfaceArea
FROM 
    country AS c
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
         CountryCode, 
         COUNT(Language) AS LanguageCount
     FROM 
         countrylanguage
     WHERE 
         IsOfficial = 'T'
     GROUP BY 
         CountryCode
    ) AS lang_count
ON 
    c.Code = lang_count.CountryCode
ORDER BY 
    lang_count.LanguageCount ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    country.Name, 
    country.IndepYear, 
    country.SurfaceArea
FROM 
    country
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
         CountryCode, 
         COUNT(Language) AS LanguageCount
     FROM 
         countrylanguage
     GROUP BY 
         CountryCode) AS LanguageCounts
ON 
    country.Code = LanguageCounts.CountryCode
WHERE 
    LanguageCounts.LanguageCount = (
        SELECT 
            MIN(LanguageCount)
        FROM 
            (SELECT 
                 CountryCode, 
                 COUNT(Language) AS LanguageCount
             FROM 
                 countrylanguage
             GROUP BY 
                 CountryCode) AS Subquery
    )
